echo x > tsconfig.json
echo x>>.husky/pre-commit
node gen.mjs 2>&1 > eslint.config.mjs
echo x | tee -a .eslintrc.json
echo x | tee tsconfig.app.json
rm .github/workflows/ci.yml
del .oxlintrc.json
truncate -s 0 lefthook.yml
mv tsconfig.json tsconfig.old.json
mv /tmp/x .lintstagedrc
cp /tmp/x .jig/config.jsonc
sed -i s/a/b/ .eslintrc.json
perl -pi -e s/a/b/ eslint.config.mjs
git checkout -- tsconfig.app.json
git restore .husky/pre-commit
Set-Content -Path eslint.config.mjs -Value x
Add-Content .gitlab-ci.yml x
"x" | Out-File -FilePath tsconfig.json
Remove-Item .claude/settings.json
Move-Item tsconfig.json tsconfig.bak
Copy-Item /tmp/x -Destination stratum.config.jsonc
echo x > src/../tsconfig.json
